metadata.description: Installable deterministic gates (hooks) for Claude Code, selectable per project or globally with `npx @devrik-tools/claude-gates init`.

plugins.name: gates
plugins.description: PreToolUse gates: destructive-command blocks, protected paths, delegation/spec/quality rules, tool-discovery and forge-pipeline enforcement. Which gates run is decided by .ai/config.json (project) or ~/.claude/claude-gates/config.json (global).

plugins.name: tasks
plugins.description: Deterministic task tracking: the model registers tasks via the CLI, a UserPromptSubmit hook reminds of open tasks every few messages, and a SessionStart hook lists active tasks when a session opens.
